entries.name: Koret School of Veterinary Medicine - Veterinary Teaching Hospital (Hebrew University)
entries.duty: Emergency and critical care 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Emergency line also *8818; emergency department +972 3 968 8533.
entries.note: University hospital page: switchboard 'emergencies 24/7', '24 hours a day, 365 days a year'. Koret school page (en.vetschool.agri.huji.ac.il) also says emergency service 24/7, lists school address Herzl 229 Rehovot +972 8 948 9021/31.

entries.name: Vet Center (Vet-Center Veterinary Hospital)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week including Shabbat and holidays; on-duty veterinarian. Emergency and referral hospital, no routine general care.
entries.note: Hebrew: וט סנטר. Both pages opened; 24 h wording on home and /emergency.

entries.name: Chavat Daat Haifa Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; the main number is also the 24/7 emergency line.
entries.note: Hebrew: חוות דעת חיפה. Network homepage says 3 hospitals open 24/7 (Haifa, Rehovot, Kfar Saba).

entries.name: Chavat Daat Rehovot Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; the main number is also the 24/7 emergency line.
entries.note: Hebrew: חוות דעת רחובות.

entries.name: Chavat Daat Kfar Saba Veterinary Hospital

entries.note: Hebrew: חוות דעת כפר סבא.

entries.duty: Animal hospital open 24 hours, including weekends and holidays. Emergency line +972 52 473 9482.
entries.note: Heading 'בית חולים לחיות 24 שעות'. Page lists 04-8229561 in header and as emergency; body gives emergency 0524-739-482; office 04-8232705. url is the site root derived from the page URL host.

entries.name: Veterinary Hospital at Bikar (Doctor Vet) - Yigal Alon branch
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including Friday, Saturday and holidays; no appointment needed for emergencies.
entries.note: Hebrew: בית חולים וטרינרי בכיכר. Habima branch (Ben Tzion 17, same phone) has set hours Sun-Thu only, not 24 h; not listed separately.

entries.name: Pet Holim (Dr. Yuval Samuel) - Tel Aviv
entries.duty: Emergency veterinarian available 24 hours a day including Shabbat and holidays: +972 72 279 1610. Other branches: Kfar Saba +972 72 279 1608, Kfar Shmaryahu +972 50 649 3693, Tzur Yigal +972 72 279 1609.
entries.note: Hebrew: פט חולים. Page opened; regular hours per branch not listed. 24 h applies to the emergency vet line.

entries.name: Dr. Sherman Veterinary Center of the Negev
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-13:00 and 16:00-20:00, Fri 9:00-13:00. Emergency service in Be'er Sheva and area 24 hours a day including Saturdays and holidays: +972 50 754 5907.
entries.note: Hebrew: ד"ר שרמן. 24 h wording only on the emergency-services page; home page gives hours 9-13/16-21 and conflicting emergency number 050-7575907 in one link. Lehavim branch Rimon Blvd 1, +972 8 868 2728.

entries.name: Vet4Pet - Dr. Efi Wagshal
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-13:00 and 16:00-20:00, Fri 9:00-14:00; outside these hours the emergency line (same number) answers; Shabbat and holidays by phone arrangement.
entries.note: 24 h applies to the phone emergency service, not a staffed walk-in clinic.

entries.name: Ahavat HaChai Emergency Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-20:30, Fri and holidays 9:00-14:00; medical team stated as available 24/7. Emergency: +972 52 464 6869.
entries.note: Hebrew: אהבת החי. Page says 'הזמין 24/7' but posted hours are limited; unclear if on-site round the clock.

entries.name: Dr. Uri Prise Veterinary Medical Center
entries.duty: Emergency phone line and on-call vet available 24/7, including nights and weekends; call ahead. Mobile +972 52 450 4856.
entries.note: Hebrew: ד"ר אורי פרייז. Page says 'זמין עבורכם 24/7'; refers to other 24/7 centers when it cannot help. Regular hours not listed.

entries.name: Teivat Noach (Dr. Avi Hagag)
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 10:00-12:00 and 16:30-19:30, Fri and holiday eves 9:00-13:00. Telephone available 24 hours a day; emergency line +972 54 472 8711.
entries.note: Hebrew: תיבת נח. Page: 'אנחנו זמינים בטלפון 24 שעות ביממה' - 24 h applies to the phone line only.

entries.name: Kalaniot Center Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Available for emergencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
entries.note: Hebrew: מרכז כלניות. Address and regular hours not on the contact page. Fax number garbled.

entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-13:00 and 16:00-21:00, Fri and holiday eves 9:30-15:00. Emergency service until midnight: +972 53 680 8788.
entries.note: Page does not claim 24 h.

entries.name: Dr. Yuval Atias Emergency Veterinary Clinic (Poleg)

entries.note: Hebrew: ד"ר יובל אטיאס. Page does not say 24 h.

entries.duty: Sun-Thu 10:00-12:30 and 16:30-20:00, Fri 10:00-15:00, Sat closed. Vets reachable 24 hours a day for urgent cases outside opening hours (the clinic is not open 24/7).
entries.note: Hebrew: המרכז הוטרינרי. Branches: Ramat Gan, Bat Yam Herzl, Bat Yam Mivtza Sinai. Page: 'לא 24/7' for clinic but doctors reachable 24 h. Doctor mobiles on page not stored (personal).

entries.name: Veterinary Medical Center Ilan
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-19:00, Fri 9:00-14:00. Emergency line for clients: +972 52 340 3020; 24-hour hospitalization for monitored patients.
entries.note: Page does not say the clinic is open 24 h; 24 h is hospitalization only.

entries.note: Page shows two conflicting hour schedules; the first is used. No 24 h wording.

entries.note: Page has 'On Call Emergencies' heading but no number and no 24 h wording. Second phone on page (+970 59 890 4046) not stored.

notes: Official bodies: Ministry of Agriculture Veterinary Services and Animal Health and IVMA were searched but no public duty-rota or clinic directory page was found/opened. No animal poison information line found (none listed on any opened page). No municipal duty rota found. Not opened/skipped: veterinartoran.co.il (Vet Toran 24/7 chain, Ibn Gabirol 77 Tel Aviv and others) - fetch blocked, only aggregator (atly) saw the 24/7 claim; emergency-veterinary.co.il (Chavat Daat emergency centre) - robots disallow; veteilatclinic.wixsite.com - fetch blocked; vets-clinic.co.il (Jerusalem) and kupet.co.il - fetch failed. Jerusalem, Tel Aviv and Netanya 24 h coverage is thin: only Doctor Vet at Bikar and Pet Holim (Tel Aviv) confirmed on own sites; no Jerusalem 24 h clinic confirmed on an own page. Left: Vet Toran, Jerusalem, Hadera, Ashkelon, Beersheba additional, Haifa Krayot, Petah Tikva/Kfar Saba other clinics, Tel Aviv non-24h clinics.
